auth_sessions_revocation_consistent.name: auth_sessions_revocation_consistent
auth_sessions_revocation_consistent.value: ("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" is null) or ("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and coalesce("auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" in ('LOGOUT', 'REGENERATED'), false))

contract_items_fields_by_kind.name: contract_items_fields_by_kind
contract_items_fields_by_kind.value:
case "contract_items"."item_kind"
        when 'HOURLY_RATE' then "contract_items"."unit" is not null and "contract_items"."unit_price" is not null
        when 'MILESTONE' then "contract_items"."milestone_ref" is not null and "contract_items"."agreed_amount" is not null
        when 'PO_LINE' then "contract_items"."agreed_quantity" is not null and "contract_items"."unit_price" is not null
        when 'FIXED_FEE' then "contract_items"."agreed_amount" is not null
        else false end

contract_items_amounts_positive.name: contract_items_amounts_positive
contract_items_amounts_positive.value: coalesce("contract_items"."unit_price" > 0, true) and coalesce("contract_items"."agreed_quantity" > 0, true) and coalesce("contract_items"."agreed_amount" > 0, true)

contract_versions_confirmation_consisten.name: contract_versions_confirmation_consistent
contract_versions_confirmation_consisten.value: ("contract_versions"."status" = 'CONFIRMED') = ("contract_versions"."confirmed_by_user_id" is not null and "contract_versions"."confirmed_at" is not null)

invoice_lines_amounts_valid.name: invoice_lines_amounts_valid
invoice_lines_amounts_valid.value: "invoice_lines"."subtotal" >= 0 and coalesce("invoice_lines"."quantity" > 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_lines"."unit_price" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_lines"."tax_amount" >= 0, true)

invoice_versions_amounts_non_negative.name: invoice_versions_amounts_non_negative
invoice_versions_amounts_non_negative.value: coalesce("invoice_versions"."subtotal" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_versions"."taxes" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_versions"."discounts" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_versions"."total_amount" >= 0, true)
